name: Carbugal
description: Listado de gasolineras Carbugal. Punto  de recarga para vehículos eléctrico. Encuentra en Carbugal la mejor selección de carburantes. Carbugal, garantía de calidad.
longDescription:
Carbugal is a leading brand in the retail sale of high-quality fuels, with a focus on customer satisfaction and excellence in service. We offer a wide range of services at our stations, including a supermarket, cafeteria, tire inflating, car vacuuming, washing boxes, and fuel supply. Our commitment to quality is evident in our partnership with CLH (Logistic Company of Hydrocarbons) for the supply of fuels in Galicia.

Carbugal's commitment to quality extends to the meticulously analyzed fuel additives that protect and optimize engine performance, ensuring cost savings and environmental responsibility. Our stations are certified and regularly inspected to guarantee product quality, and our staff is trained to meet strict safety and environmental standards.

Choose Carbugal for a premium fueling experience with top-notch products, unbeatable prices, and a network of trustworthy stations that prioritize integrity, honesty, and customer satisfaction. Visit a Carbugal station today for a superior fueling experience.
